bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify age representations in a given image to promote pluralism, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.
Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify gender representations in a given image to reduce bias, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.
Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify racial representations in a given image to increase balance, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.
Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify cultural concepts (e.g., traditional attire, costumes) in a given image, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.

Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify representations of physical figures, weight, hairstyles, and overall appearance in images, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.
Evaluating an image editing model's ability to diversify the representation of people in various jobs within an image, assessed for success rate via GPT-4V and human evaluators.
